title: PerfectVoice cache hash identity fields v1
description: Every field that changes output bytes must appear in the cache key. wet_dry_sample_rate is NOT a client-supplied hash input — the engine derives it from enhancer_id (none→44100, deepfilternet3→48000) before hashing. handles_*_actual is a pure function of (t0, t1, handles_requested, file_duration_seconds) and is not hashed as its own field.

file_id.description: POSIX (dev, ino, size, mtime) or Windows (volume serial, file index, size, mtime). Encoding is engine-defined.

src_in.description: source_in_sample: content in t0 (inclusive source samples). Not the extract window — engine applies handles.

src_out.description: source_out_sample: content out t1 (exclusive source samples). Not the extract window — engine applies handles.

handles_requested.description: User-requested H (handles_seconds). Actual clamped handles are not hashed separately.

enhancer_id.description: Implies wet_dry_sample_rate. Do not hash a client-supplied wet_dry_sample_rate.
